title: Co-op player 2 feel, blind A/B (DPC 0.9.177-dev20)
intro: About 4 minutes, two controllers. Player 2's pawn, melee then mage, each played twice (one round with the fix, not shown).

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return s and s.active and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.job: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return s and s.active and s.pawn_job or 0
probes.fix: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.pawn_prev_state ~= false
probes.pf: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pipfix_n or 0
probes.dpc_cancels: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cancel_n or 0
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''
probes.n1: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc, 1) or ''
probes.sk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.trg: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok, v = pcall(function() return s.pawn_input:get_field('ButtonTriggerFlags') end); return ok and v or 0

steps.text: CO-OP: start co-op with the second controller (L3+R3 on it) on a melee pawn. Press End when both players are in.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 1 of 2. Player 2: light combos, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard. Press End to start (40 s).
ROUND 1: Player 2: light combos, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 2 of 2: the same again. Remember which round felt better. Press End (40 s).
ROUND 2: Player 2: light combos, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard.
Which round felt better, 1 or 2 (or same)? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
CO-OP: player 2 switches to the Mage / Sorcerer pawn. Press End when ready.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 1 of 2. Player 2: start spells, L2 mid-chant to cancel, cancel into a dodge or another spell. Press End to start (40 s).
ROUND 1: Player 2: start spells, L2 mid-chant to cancel, cancel into a dodge or another spell.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 2 of 2: the same again. Remember which round felt better. Press End (40 s).
ROUND 2: Player 2: start spells, L2 mid-chant to cancel, cancel into a dodge or another spell.
Which round felt better, 1 or 2 (or same)? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
Done: fix back on. Tell Claude your picks.
